metadata.question: Does the vegetation cover in Robinson Crusoe Island show higher greenness compared to Santa Clara Island in November 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location 1: Robinson Crusoe Island (coordinates: ~-33.64, -78.84) - Location 2: Santa Clara Island (coordinates: ~-33.75, -78.82) - Date: November 2018 (2018-11-01 to 2018-11-30) - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good for vegetation indices like NDVI) - Fallback: Landsat 8 if Sentinel-2 fails 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask using QA60 band for Sentinel-2 (mask clouds and cirrus) - Calculate NDVI as a greenness indicator - Compare mean NDVI values between the two islands 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Check image collection sizes first - Validate pixel counts after cloud masking (if 0 pixels remain, output C2) - Validate NDVI values are within [-1, 1] range - Compare mean NDVI: if Robinson Crusoe NDVI > Santa Clara NDVI, answer A, else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries const robinsonCrusoe = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.84, -33.64]); const santaClara = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.82, -33.75]); const dateStart = '2018-11-01'; const dateEnd = '2018-11-30'; // 2. Load Sentinel-2 collection let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(robinsonCrusoe.buffer(5000)) .filterMetadata('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 'less_than', 50); let count = col.size().getInfo(); // Check for empty collection if (count === 0) { console.log('Sentinel-2 No images found in Nov 2018 for Robinson Crusoe.'); // Try Landsat 8 fallback col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(robinsonCrusoe.buffer(5000)); count = col.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { console.log('Landsat 8 also empty.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } console.log('Images found: ' + count); // 3. Function to calculate NDVI function calcNDVI(img) { // For Sentinel-2 if (img.bandNames().contains('B4').getInfo && img.bandNames().contains('B4').getInfo()) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); const mask = img.select('QA60').lt(1024); // Mask clouds return ndvi.updateMask(mask); } else { // For Landsat 8 const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(8).eq(0)); // Remove clouds/shadows return ndvi.updateMask(mask); } } // 4. Calculate NDVI for Robinson Crusoe const ndvi_rc = col.map(calcNDVI).mean(); const stats_rc = ndvi_rc.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: robinsonCrusoe.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val_rc = stats_rc.NDVI; const pix_rc = stats_rc['NDVI_count']; // Check for valid pixels if (pix_rc === 0 || pix_rc === null) { console.log('RC No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate NDVI for Santa Clara (expand search area) let col_sc = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(santaClara.buffer(5000)) .filterMetadata('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 'less_than', 50); if (col_sc.size().getInfo() === 0) { col_sc = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(santaClara.buffer(5000)); } if (col_sc.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('SC No images found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const ndvi_sc = col_sc.map(calcNDVI).mean(); const stats_sc = ndvi_sc.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: santaClara.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val_sc = stats_sc.NDVI; const pix_sc = stats_sc['NDVI_count']; if (pix_sc === 0 || pix_sc === null) { console.log('SC No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Validate results if (val_rc === null || val_sc === null || val_rc === undefined || val_sc === undefined) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (val_rc < -1 || val_rc > 1 || val_sc < -1 || val_sc > 1) { console.log('NDVI out of valid range [-1, 1].'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Final comparison console.log('RC NDVI: ' + val_rc.toFixed(3) + ' (pixels: ' + pix_rc + ')'); console.log('SC NDVI: ' + val_sc.toFixed(3) + ' (pixels: ' + pix_sc + ')'); if (val_rc > val_sc) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
